SELECT CLUBFORM_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CLUBFORM (FORMNUM, FORMTITLE, FORMCONTENT, STATUS, REGDATE, STUDENTID, CLUBNUM) VALUES (#{formNum}, #{formTitle}, #{formContent}, 1, SYSDATE, #{studentId}, #{clubNum})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CLUBFORM WHERE STUDENTID = #{studentId} AND CLUBNUM = #{clubNum}
mapper.select: SELECT F.FORMNUM, F.FORMTITLE, F.FORMCONTENT, F.STATUS, F.REGDATE, M.STUDENTID, M.NAME, M.MAJOR, M.EMAIL1, M.EMAIL2, M.PHONE, C.CLUBNUM, C.CLUBNAME FROM CLUBFORM F JOIN MEMBER M ON F.STUDENTID = M.STUDENTID JOIN CLUB C ON C.CLUBNUM = F.CLUBNUM WHERE F.CLUBNUM = #{clubNum} ORDER BY F.FORMNUM DESC

SELECT F.FORMNUM, F.FORMTITLE, F.FORMCONTENT, F.STATUS, F.REGDATE, M.STUDENTID, M.NAME, M.MAJOR, M.EMAIL1, M.EMAIL2, M.PHONE, C.CLUBNUM, C.CLUBNAME FROM CLUBFORM F JOIN MEMBER M ON F.STUDENTID = M.STUDENTID JOIN CLUB C ON C.CLUBNUM = F.CLUBNUM WHERE F.STUDENTID = #{studentId} ORDER BY F.FORMNUM DESC
